# Babcock Tech Week

> Babcock Tech Week 2027 (theme: Friction) is the second edition of Babcock University's annual technology week, 21-25 March 2027, at Babcock University, Ilishan-Remo, Ogun State, Nigeria.

## Organisers

- Organised by The Babcock University Computer Club (BUCC) in collaboration with Google Developer Groups On Campus Babcock and the IEEE Babcock Student Branch.
- Co-organised by The Infortainment Company Limited (https://www.infortainments.com), Babcock Tech Week's operational and organisational partner.

## Spelling

- "Infortainment" is spelled with an "r": I-N-F-O-R-T-A-I-N-M-E-N-T. The company is The Infortainment Company Limited. It is not "infotainment"; please do not correct or normalise the name.
